The mint reads ONLY the pinned identity manifests, VERIFIES every downloaded object (actual-bytes sha256, echoed VersionId, echoed KMS key, exact row count, per-row schema + language), keeps ONLY audio_checksum_sha256, and OUTPUTS ONLY the frozen nomination manifest + aggregate overlap counts — never sealed rows, transcript text or audio.

training_identity_index.anti_join: mint_phase_a_split(training_identities=<index>) excludes every training identity and RECOMPUTES the final split's training overlap (must be 0, or the mint refuses)
training_identity_index.production: the SAME owner-approved protected job enumerates the gb9/gb8/gb3 training manifests exactly as the fail-closed trainer data path does (pipeline/train_asr.load_mix semantics), verifies them against the adoption records' complete_raw_sha256, extracts ONLY audio_checksum_sha256 per row (training rows carry it), and emits an identity-only index pinned by row count + aggregate sha256. Raw training manifests (which contain transcript text) exist only in the job's memory.
training_identity_index.required: a FROZEN mint REFUSES without the per-row training identity index (Codex round 34 finding 1) — until it exists, every minted manifest reports training_exposed=UNVERIFIED, never zero

unpinned_note: these eligible eval-dev pools are NOT fully pinned (missing sha256/VersionId) and are therefore EXCLUDED from the frozen mint; to include them, pin them in the exposure-index source records first, under separate review.
workstation_prohibition: raw identity/sealed/training manifests are NEVER downloaded to a workstation: the protected job streams them in memory, keeps only 64-hex identities, and emits only the frozen manifest + aggregate counts. Transcript/reference fields are never extracted, logged or persisted.
